name: Build profiles
author: Brett
description: Pick and save the build profile the console works on. A build profile is one complete set of work data: plan (+ media), build queue, pending builds, catalog status + tracker, and the Build orchestrator's builds. Main framework is the base profile; Refactor started empty. Switching changes it for every device and session (sessions can override with AXF_BUILD_PROFILE). Banner chip shows the profile in force; tap it, the app menu (Builds → Build profile), the right-click menu or Settings → Plugins → Build profiles to switch, create, rename or take a profile off the list (its data stays). Profiles are framework data (framework/cli/profiles.mjs): removing this plugin leaves them in place.
